Intel® Core™ i3-14100 14th Generation Processor is a powerful yet budget-friendly CPU for everyday computing. With 4 performance cores, 8 threads, and a 12MB Intel® Smart Cache, this processor delivers excellent speed and responsiveness for office work, browsing, and productivity tasks.

Running at a base frequency of 3.50 GHz and capable of reaching up to 4.70 GHz turbo boost, the i3-14100 ensures smooth multitasking and fast application loading. It also features Intel® UHD Graphics 730, making it suitable for basic graphics needs without a dedicated GPU.

Compatible with LGA1700 socket motherboards, this processor supports both DDR5 and DDR4 RAM, ensuring flexibility for various system builds.
